description: Controlled cross-file cases. Each has a vulnerable/ tree with exactly one real flow and a safe/ twin with the same structure and no flow. 'expected' is the sink (file, line, CWE); 'hops' is the number of files the data crosses before the sink.

cases.shape: handler passes request data to a helper module that builds the query
handler -> service -> shell helper, three files
the request read is hidden in a helper module that returns it
a helper module either sanitizes (safe twin) or returns the value unchanged
module-level instance of a DAO class, method call across files
dependency injected through an annotated constructor parameter
route passes req.query to a required helper that calls exec
constructor-function DAO (NodeGoat style) instantiated in another file
TypeScript class injected through a constructor parameter property
